title: nyc-landmark-decarbonization: code and data for "Fuel, not age: LL97 exposure of New York City's landmark buildings"
description: Python scripts, derived data, figures and an interactive map for the study Fuel, not age: LL97 exposure of New York City's landmark buildings (Tug, 2026). The code links New York City's 2024 energy benchmarking data (Local Law 84), the Landmarks Preservation Commission building database and the Department of Buildings' Local Law 97 Covered Buildings List, recomputes each building's emissions and limits under LL97, and includes a case study of New York Public Library buildings. Version 1.1 adds the same analysis for Seattle (Building Emissions Performance Standard) and Boston (BERDO 2.0). Interactive maps for all three cities: https://tugesra.github.io/nyc-landmark-decarbonization/
